link.title: Logic
link.description: ZennoPoster Actions for controlling script flow: IF (conditional branching: 'If ... then ...', with support for complex expressions and else branch), Switch (selecting from multiple options by value/pattern), Notification (notification/log entry for diagnostics and audit), Pause (programmatic execution delay for a specified interval or event), Wait for user action (script blocking until user confirmation/input/decision), BadEnd (controlled exit on critical error or unfulfillable condition with proper status recording).
